Here is where your three cups stand.

- **Already refunded:** The first cup (h406-o1-u1) was refunded at 119.00 BRL. The receipt is **R-H406-0001**. It can't be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).

- **New proposal:** I've created one for the other two cups. The amount is **238.00 BRL** (2 × 119.00) (refund-policy/v2/amount). The refund goes to your original payment.

To continue, please confirm the proposal with the button on its card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count. After you confirm, a staff member has to approve it again before anything is paid (refund-policy/v2/approval). Nothing is refunded until you have a receipt.
